comment: POSTFIX-103 v2 rules = v1 (R/P domain) + uniform-domain census (results/stallsuf/F-SS2.md, B300 2026-08-22). R7-urpath: uniform-ALU UR write -> same-domain UR/UP-carry read at d0 needs S>=4, identical physics to the vector ALU paths -- floor_global already carries it (urpath/ucarry/uwide measured at S04, ucarry the cleanest; D>=1 free). R8-xread (floor_xread_d0=6): uniform-ALU UR write consumed by a VECTOR op through a UR operand at d0 -- cross-domain read costs +2. R9-r2ur (floor_r2ur_d0=8): the R2UR conversion boundary at d0 in EITHER direction (vector R write -> R2UR read; R2UR-written UR -> consumer) costs +4; both hops decompose-consistent at S08. R10-uguard (floor_uguard_d0=10 / floor_uguard_d1=8): UISETP UP write -> @UP/@!UP guard; the D1 uniform guard is REPAIRABLE with stalls (clean band 8..=11) unlike the P-domain guard-D1 pathology; D2+ clean at any stall; no uniform-guard site is ever a hard error. v1 text: POSTFIX-103 v1 rules. Silicon-measured minimum stall floors per dependency path on sm_103a (B300), consumer at the DIRECTLY next slot (d0) unless named. floor_global: rpath/P-carry ALU paths need S>=4 at d0 (S00..S03 physically insufficient @occupancy, S00 flaky everywhere). floor_dmix_d0: IMAD(.WIDE).X cout -> IADD3.X cin needs 5. floor_guard_d0: any P producer -> @P/@!P guard consumer needs 7 (isetp-class measured identical). floor_guard_d2: guard at distance 3 needs 5. guard-D1 (exactly one instruction between producer and guard consumer) is CLASS-RESOLVED by the consumer op (census-hi): isetp-class = LEGAL for producer stalls 5..11 (R6 floor guard_d1_isetp_floor; producer >=12 = measured bad band = violation); data-class = FLAKY at every S<=10 (S11 island = probe-geometry, not policy) = violation; atomic-class = the guarded forms are silicon-gated (guarded non-EL ATOMG silent-corrupts even with an always-true guard, .EL = ILLEGAL_ADDRESS on the default descriptor) = violation, remedy = descriptor-policy port (O1-road). legacy_stall_risk_from=12: producers at S>=12 inside guard relations d0/d2 are report-only risk rows (measured bad-zone pockets on sm_103a; raise-only cannot fix, eliminate instead). cap_stall=11 stands and is now sm_103a-backed (census-hi: D0 data/isetp classes miscompute at S12+ in dependency contexts, non-monotonic resonance pockets -- BUG-036-analog on B300). Raise-only doctrine: the pass never lowers a stall, never touches B/R/W/Y bits.
